releaseValidation: The Server 0.9.0, 0.9.1, and 0.9.2 release gates installed all eighteen registry-downloaded client packages against each released major-2 conformance bundle for both exact targets: 54 released-package pairs. The six published 0.4.0 packages passed all 12 fake-SDK conformance scenarios against each server (216 scenario runs); the twelve published 0.2.0/0.3.0 packages, which require contract major 1, were rejected before launch, which proves installation/startup rejection only. Server artifact hashes in every report match the published conformance ZIPs. Earlier major-1 released-package pairs and 42 development-candidate pairs, including the 0.9.0-dev.1 checks, remain recorded with their original identities. Licensed SpatialAnalyzer validation was not run for this change.
